# PyrexxAI

> PyrexxAI is an AI voice receptionist company that deploys custom-trained
> voice agents for MedSpas, dental clinics, and therapy practices in the US.
> We handle inbound call answering, appointment booking (direct EMR write),
> lead intake, and 24/7 patient communication — HIPAA-compliant.

## Company
- Founded by: Clifford Bulya
- Headquarters: United States (Delaware incorporated)
- Contact: hello@pyrexxai.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/PyrexxAI

## Core Service
- Done-for-you AI voice receptionist implementation (not a SaaS tool)
- Live in 14 days from kickoff to production
- Integrates natively with Jane App, Mindbody, eClinicalWorks and other EMRs
- Handles unlimited concurrent calls (zero hold times)
- Business Associate Agreement (BAA) included with all clients
- Pricing: $1,500 implementation + $1,000/month platform management

## Target Clients
- Medical Spas (MedSpas)
- Dental Practices
- Therapy and Mental Health Clinics
